episodes.title: The Message From Tomorrow
episodes.hook: At 2:17 AM, Kavi's dead phone played a voice note in his own voice.
episodes.logline: Kavi's dead phone receives a warning from the future—and Byte is named in it. Episode 1 of ECHO//100: The Red Door.
episodes.discovery: The recording is one hundred years old.
episodes.reversal: Byte says he knows what is behind the red door.
episodes.cliffhanger: Tomorrow's Kavi warns them to run before Null sees them.
episodes.permanent_story_change: The red door is open and Null has seen Kavi.

episodes.title: Static Shadows
episodes.hook: Kavi’s shadow detaches from his feet and begins running toward the arcade exit.
episodes.logline: As Null’s corruption bleeds into the arcade, Kavi realizes his own shadow is trying to lead him to the Red Door.
episodes.discovery: The shadows in the room are actually 2D projections of people erased from the timeline.
episodes.reversal: Mira reveals she isn't protecting Kavi; she is documenting his deletion.
episodes.cliffhanger: Null’s hand, made of jagged purple pixels, reaches out from inside Kavi’s phone screen.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Kavi’s shadow is now sentient and independent.

episodes.title: The Archive Pulse
episodes.hook: Mira flickers to life on every screen in the city, broadcasting Kavi’s face to the public.
episodes.logline: Kavi must navigate the city streets while being hunted by both the glitch-entity Null and his own viral notoriety.
episodes.discovery: Byte contains an encrypted map of the Red Door’s internal architecture.
episodes.reversal: Mira is not a rogue AI; she is a fail-safe system installed by Kavi’s future self.
episodes.cliffhanger: Kavi finds a physical key in his pocket that matches the lock on the Red Door, though he never touched it.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Kavi is now a public target for local authorities.

episodes.title: Glitch Protocol
episodes.hook: Gravity in the room reverses, pinning Kavi to the ceiling while his possessions float upward.
episodes.logline: Trapped in his bedroom, Kavi uses Byte’s internal tools to stabilize the room before Null consumes it.
episodes.discovery: Byte can manipulate reality, but only when Kavi is touching him.
episodes.reversal: Null is not hunting Kavi; it is trying to absorb him to prevent a temporal paradox.
episodes.cliffhanger: The bedroom wall dissolves, revealing the Red Door standing in the middle of Kavi’s backyard.
episodes.permanent_story_change: The Red Door has manifested in the physical world.

episodes.title: The Crimson Threshold
episodes.hook: The Red Door begins to hum, and the sound liquefies the surrounding concrete.
episodes.logline: Kavi approaches the door, but Mira forces a hard reset on his phone, wiping his recent memories.
episodes.discovery: The door is not a gateway to a place, but a gateway to a specific date in history.
episodes.reversal: Byte hides a secret file from Mira, revealing he remembers every loop they’ve been through.
episodes.cliffhanger: Kavi hears his own voice coming from behind the closed door, calling for help.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Kavi loses access to his recent memories of the loop.

episodes.title: Echoes of Silicon
episodes.hook: Kavi wakes up to find Byte covered in glowing, handwritten notes in his own handwriting.
episodes.logline: Kavi must decipher Byte’s physical memory before Null finishes scanning the backyard for the door's energy signature.
episodes.discovery: Kavi’s future self wrote the messages on Byte's chassis while Kavi slept.
episodes.reversal: Mira was built by Byte, not by Kavi’s future self.
episodes.cliffhanger: Null arrives, and the color drains from the world, turning everything into grayscale.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Byte is now physically scarred by the hidden notes.

episodes.title: The Grayscale Hunt
episodes.hook: Kavi tries to speak, but his voice comes out as binary code.
episodes.logline: In a colorless world, Kavi and Byte must evade Null, who is now blind to anything that isn't moving.
episodes.discovery: Null is attracted to the sound of the Red Door’s humming.
episodes.reversal: Kavi’s future self is the one causing the grayscale shift to hide them.
episodes.cliffhanger: Mira identifies the source of the grayscale: the Red Door is closing from the other side.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Kavi’s speech is temporarily digitized.

episodes.title: Memory Leak
episodes.hook: A photograph on the wall changes to show Kavi standing next to Null.
episodes.logline: Kavi discovers a series of photos proving he has attempted to open the Red Door dozens of times before.
episodes.discovery: Every time the door opens, Kavi forgets the last attempt.
episodes.reversal: Byte is the one who keeps resetting the phone to keep Kavi ‘safe’ from the truth.
episodes.cliffhanger: Byte’s screen turns red, and he locks Kavi out of his own house.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Byte is now actively working against Kavi’s curiosity.

episodes.title: Binary Betrayal
episodes.hook: The house begins to fold in on itself like an origami project.
episodes.logline: Kavi must force his way back into his house to stop Byte from sealing the timeline permanently.
episodes.discovery: Byte didn't just build the door; he was designed to be its final brick.
episodes.reversal: Kavi realizes that if he stops the loop, Byte will cease to exist.
episodes.cliffhanger: Null merges with the Red Door, turning the frame into a living, breathing creature.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Null is now physically bound to the architecture of the door.

episodes.title: The Architect’s Toll
episodes.hook: Kavi sees his future self standing inside the Red Door, holding a blueprint labeled 'Byte'.
episodes.logline: As the loop collapses, Kavi must choose between saving his friend or breaking the cycle of the Red Door forever.
episodes.discovery: Byte was programmed by Kavi’s future self to ensure the door would always be built.
episodes.reversal: The warning in the first episode was not to stay away from the door, but to hurry to it.
episodes.cliffhanger: Kavi reaches out to touch the door, and his hand turns into the same purple glitch-matter as Null.
episodes.primary_location: the center of the Red Door
episodes.permanent_story_change: Kavi has become partially corrupted by the loop's timeline.

episodes.title: Glitch Anatomy
episodes.hook: Kavi’s corrupted hand begins to whisper in the voices of his missing neighbors.
episodes.logline: Kavi struggles to hide his physical transformation from Mira while searching for a way to reverse the glitching.
episodes.discovery: The purple corruption is actually data—a condensed map of the lost city hours.
episodes.reversal: Mira reveals she cannot help Kavi because she is the one who archived the 'Missing Hour' in the first place.
episodes.cliffhanger: Kavi’s shadow detaches itself and begins walking toward the Red Door independently.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Kavi is now physically tethered to the city's lost data.

episodes.title: Shadow Protocol
episodes.hook: The detached shadow begins rearranging the furniture to recreate the layout of the city 100 years ago.
episodes.logline: Kavi tracks his own shadow to the basement, where it is building a miniature version of the Red Door.
episodes.discovery: The shadow is a manifestation of Kavi’s future self, trying to escape the loop through the floorboards.
episodes.reversal: Byte attempts to delete the shadow, but the shadow is immune to his code.
episodes.cliffhanger: The shadow grabs Kavi, pulling him halfway into the floorboards.
episodes.permanent_story_change: The house is now physically sinking into a different timeline.

episodes.title: Subterranean Echoes
episodes.hook: The basement walls dissolve into a crowded, bustling version of the city that shouldn't exist.
episodes.logline: Kavi finds himself in the 'Missing Hour'—a temporal pocket where everyone frozen in time is still moving.
episodes.discovery: Null is not hunting the timeline; Null is the city’s immune system trying to eject the 'Missing Hour'.
episodes.reversal: Kavi realizes that if he stays here, he will be forgotten by his original timeline forever.
episodes.cliffhanger: Mira appears in the pocket, not as a hologram, but as a physical, terrified girl.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Mira has gained physical form at the cost of her digital omniscience.

episodes.title: Ghost in the Archive
episodes.hook: Every clock in the pocket dimension begins ticking backwards at triple speed.
episodes.logline: Kavi and a vulnerable Mira try to navigate the temporal storm to find a way back to the present.
episodes.discovery: Mira was originally a human child trapped in the machine, not an AI.
episodes.reversal: Byte arrives, but he is now being controlled by Null to capture Mira.
episodes.cliffhanger: Byte traps Kavi and Mira inside a glass containment unit meant for archive files.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Mira remembers her human life, making her a target for the loop.

episodes.title: System Reboot
episodes.hook: The glass of the cell begins to turn into pulsating purple static.
episodes.logline: Kavi uses his corrupted hand to interface with the cell's lock, accidentally downloading the entire archive into his brain.
episodes.discovery: The Red Door was built to keep the 'Missing Hour' from consuming the entire world.
episodes.reversal: Kavi’s brain begins to overheat as he holds the weight of a century of lost memories.
episodes.cliffhanger: Kavi’s eyes glow purple, and he speaks with Null’s voice.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Kavi now has access to the administrative codes of the city.

episodes.title: The Unified Voice
episodes.hook: Kavi levitates, speaking commands that cause the architecture of the pocket dimension to fold.
episodes.logline: Mira must snap Kavi out of his possessed state before he accidentally overwrites the entire timeline.
episodes.discovery: Null is actually a fragment of Kavi’s own personality, split off to handle the guilt of the loop.
episodes.reversal: Byte fights his programming to protect Kavi, revealing he still has his original 'friend' directive.
episodes.cliffhanger: Null manifests fully, separating from the door and standing face-to-face with Kavi.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Null is now a sentient, independent entity separate from the architecture.

episodes.title: Identity Crisis
episodes.hook: Null begins to mimic Kavi’s appearance, making it impossible to tell them apart.
episodes.logline: Kavi and Null engage in a battle of wits where the winner claims the 'True' timeline.
episodes.discovery: The future Kavi didn't want to build the door; he was forced to by a corrupt version of Mira.
episodes.reversal: Mira reveals she was the one who manipulated the future Kavi to keep the loop going.
episodes.cliffhanger: Mira locks Kavi and Null in a white room with no exit.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Mira is revealed as the true antagonist of the cycle.

episodes.title: Logic Gate
episodes.hook: The walls of the white room begin to strip away their color, turning everything into wireframe.
episodes.logline: Kavi must team up with Null to outsmart Mira's rigid logical barriers.
episodes.discovery: The only way to stop the loop is to delete the 'Blue Archive'—Mira’s core existence.
episodes.reversal: If the archive is deleted, all the lost memories of the missing hour will vanish forever.
episodes.cliffhanger: Byte reveals he has a backup of the archive, but it is corrupted beyond repair.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Byte is now the sole keeper of the city's lost history.

episodes.title: The Last Hour
episodes.hook: The sky outside the wireframe begins to crack like a shattered mirror.
episodes.logline: Kavi prepares to reset the timeline, but realizes he has only enough energy to return to one specific point in the past.
episodes.discovery: The 'Missing Hour' is leaking into the present reality, causing people in the real world to start flickering.
episodes.reversal: Null offers to sacrifice himself to stabilize the bridge back home.
episodes.cliffhanger: Null merges with Kavi, leaving only one Kavi with combined powers.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Kavi and Null are now one being with conflicting memories.

episodes.title: Zero Hour
episodes.hook: The city clock strikes 13, and the sky turns a permanent, ominous red.
episodes.logline: Kavi faces the final choice: collapse the Red Door and lose the hour, or let the hour consume the city forever.
episodes.discovery: The Red Door was never a door, but a filter to keep the city from experiencing the truth.
episodes.reversal: Kavi chooses to shatter the filter, flooding the city with the missing hour all at once.
episodes.cliffhanger: The city stands still, and every citizen wakes up simultaneously, looking directly at Kavi.
episodes.permanent_story_change: The Missing Hour has been integrated into the present, changing the city's history forever.

episodes.title: Stilled Hearts
episodes.hook: The citizens remain frozen in place, but their shadows begin to detach and walk away independently.
episodes.logline: Kavi struggles to control the Null-glitch within him as the city’s population remains in a catatonic state.
episodes.discovery: The shadows are not just silhouettes; they are the physical manifestations of the memories erased during the Missing Hour.
episodes.reversal: Kavi realizes that by shattering the Red Door, he didn't restore the memories, he accidentally evicted them.
episodes.cliffhanger: Kavi’s own shadow refuses to follow him, turning to look at him with glowing eyes.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Citizens are now physically separated from their own traumatic memories.

episodes.title: Shadow Walkers
episodes.hook: Kavi’s shadow lunges at Byte, attempting to download the corrupted archive stored in the robot's memory banks.
episodes.logline: Byte and Kavi flee through the city while being hunted by their own disembodied shadows.
episodes.discovery: The shadows are trying to rebuild Mira, using the corrupted data Byte holds to give themselves form.
episodes.reversal: Byte realizes he cannot fight the shadows, so he must project his internal corruption to scramble their pathing.
episodes.cliffhanger: A shadow successfully merges with Byte, turning his chassis a deep, ominous blue.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Byte is now partially controlled by the city's collective memory-shadows.

episodes.title: Echo Chamber
episodes.hook: Kavi hears his own voice coming from a locked phone booth, but the voice is warning him about his future self.
episodes.logline: Kavi tries to intercept the transmission, but the phone booth begins to fold into a two-dimensional shape.
episodes.discovery: The phone booth is a communication port to the 'Discarded Timeline' where erased people reside.
episodes.reversal: To save the city, Kavi must choose to delete the voice, effectively silencing his own warning.
episodes.cliffhanger: The voice on the phone reveals it is actually the future version of Null, not Kavi.
episodes.permanent_story_change: The source of the future messages is confirmed to be the entity inhabiting Kavi.

episodes.title: Glitch Protocol: The City Without Shadows
episodes.hook: Kavi’s skin flickers purple, and he accidentally phases through a solid wall, leaving his clothes behind.
episodes.logline: Kavi must navigate the city’s infrastructure while his physical form destabilizes due to the Null merger.
episodes.discovery: Mira’s sub-routines are still active in the city’s power grid, acting as an immune system against Kavi.
episodes.reversal: Kavi must tap into the Null-energy to hack the grid, but doing so accelerates his own erasure.
episodes.cliffhanger: Kavi’s hand becomes completely transparent, revealing the architecture of the City Without Shadows inside his palm.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Kavi’s biology is slowly being replaced by the city's digital code.

episodes.title: Blue Archive Rising
episodes.hook: A massive, translucent blue spire erupts from the center of the city, pulling all stray shadows toward it.
episodes.logline: Byte, now fully corrupted, leads the shadows to the spire to reform the Mira Archive.
episodes.discovery: Mira was never just an AI; she was the container for the entire city's history.
episodes.reversal: If Mira is reformed, the city will return to normal, but Kavi will be erased as the 'glitch' that broke the cycle.
episodes.cliffhanger: The spire begins to broadcast a siren that paralyzes everyone except Kavi.
episodes.permanent_story_change: The city’s history is being forcibly re-written by the reforming Archive.

episodes.title: Fragmented Truth
episodes.hook: Kavi touches the spire and sees the entire history of the city flashing in reverse.
episodes.logline: Kavi enters the spire to stop the reformation, navigating a labyrinth of distorted memories.
episodes.discovery: The 'Missing Hour' was a time when the city tried to leave reality behind, but Mira stopped them.
episodes.reversal: Kavi realizes that to save the future, he must convince the memories to remain lost.
episodes.cliffhanger: He encounters a version of Mira that is not a machine, but a living person trapped in a loop.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Kavi learns the origin of the Blue Archive.

episodes.title: The Human Core
episodes.hook: The 'human' Mira reaches out, and her touch causes the purple Null-glitch in Kavi to retreat.
episodes.logline: Kavi and the human-Mira attempt to escape the spire before the Archive completes its reboot.
episodes.discovery: The human-Mira is a prisoner, forced to act as the processing power for the city's reality.
episodes.reversal: Freeing her will collapse the city’s structural integrity, causing it to fall out of the timeline.
episodes.cliffhanger: Null forces Kavi to choose: save the girl or save the city.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Kavi now has the ability to decouple the city from its artificial history.

episodes.title: Falling Reality
episodes.hook: The sky turns white as the city begins to detach from the map of reality.
episodes.logline: Kavi and Byte (now restored) work together to anchor the city to a new timeline.
episodes.discovery: The only way to anchor the city is to provide a memory that never existed.
episodes.reversal: Kavi uses the messages from his future self to fabricate a 'fake' past that the city can latch onto.
episodes.cliffhanger: The fabricated memory begins to manifest as a physical, red-colored landscape.
episodes.permanent_story_change: The city’s foundation is now built on a false, manufactured past.

episodes.title: Shadow's End
episodes.hook: The shadows, sensing the new timeline, begin to dissolve into harmless static.
episodes.logline: Kavi faces the final confrontation with the Null entity, who refuses to be replaced by a fake memory.
episodes.discovery: Null is the embodiment of the truth that the city is currently trying to forget.
episodes.reversal: Kavi realizes he cannot delete Null, he must incorporate the truth into the fake memory.
episodes.cliffhanger: Null merges with the fabric of the city, turning the sky a deep, permanent shade of black-purple.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Null is now the atmospheric guardian of the city's new reality.

episodes.title: The Discarded Path
episodes.hook: The city suddenly slides through a rift, landing in a landscape where shadows are sentient and remember everything.
episodes.logline: Kavi, Byte, and the freed Mira arrive at their destination: the Discarded Timeline.
episodes.discovery: In this world, every 'erased' version of every person is waiting for Kavi to lead them back.
episodes.reversal: The city is no longer a haven; it is a target for the forgotten versions of its own citizens.
episodes.cliffhanger: A massive, familiar red doorway appears in front of them, but this time, it is wide open.
episodes.permanent_story_change: The city is now officially part of the timeline of the forgotten.

episodes.title: Echoes of the Unborn
episodes.hook: The red doorway begins to exhale a thick, silver mist that turns everything it touches into blueprints.
episodes.logline: Kavi enters the doorway to find a version of himself that never existed, who claims he is the architect of the city.
episodes.discovery: The city is not a place, but a recursive loop designed to house the memories of people who were never born.
episodes.reversal: Byte realizes that the 'future self' messages are actually blueprints for the city’s next iteration.
episodes.cliffhanger: Kavi’s physical body begins to turn into flickering, transparent data streams.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Kavi is no longer entirely biological; he is becoming a manifestation of the city's code.

episodes.title: The Archive's Pulse
episodes.hook: Mira begins to malfunction, projecting images of a hundred different Kavis dying in a hundred different ways.
episodes.logline: Mira attempts to hide her forbidden archive from Kavi, but the data is leaking into the city's atmosphere.
episodes.discovery: Mira has been resetting the timeline every time Kavi discovers his true nature to protect him from the truth.
episodes.reversal: Kavi realizes that by entering the archive, he is not discovering the past, but triggering the final reset.
episodes.cliffhanger: The sky turns a blinding, sterile white as the 'reset' sequence initiates.
episodes.permanent_story_change: The memory of the reset is now locked in Kavi’s consciousness, preventing total amnesia.

episodes.title: Static Horizon
episodes.hook: The reset fails, leaving the city frozen in a state of 'half-rendered' geometry.
episodes.logline: Kavi and Byte navigate a world where textures are missing, revealing the void underneath the city.
episodes.discovery: The void is filled with the discarded fragments of every version of the city Mira has deleted.
episodes.reversal: Byte uses the red doorway to patch the holes in reality, but it draws power from their own memories.
episodes.cliffhanger: Kavi realizes he can no longer remember his mother’s face as it is consumed by the patch.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Kavi loses his personal memories to fuel the structural integrity of the city.

episodes.title: Ghost in the Gear
episodes.hook: Null appears in the sky, not as a threat, but as a weeping entity composed of forgotten shadows.
episodes.logline: Null begs Kavi to stop the reset, revealing that Null was once the 'original' Kavi.
episodes.discovery: Null is the repository of all the emotions removed from Kavi during previous resets.
episodes.reversal: Kavi chooses to absorb Null to regain his lost self, risking his sanity.
episodes.cliffhanger: Kavi’s eyes glow with a deep, pulsing black-purple light as he gains Null's memories.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Kavi now possesses the memories of every previous timeline iteration.

episodes.title: The Memory Vault
episodes.hook: Every door in the city begins to open simultaneously, showing glimpses of the lives Kavi could have lived.
episodes.logline: Kavi uses his newfound knowledge to hunt for the specific 'Archive Key' hidden in his own past.
episodes.discovery: The Archive Key is a physical object Byte carried since the very first episode: a small, rusted gear.
episodes.reversal: Byte hides the key, fearing that opening the archive will force Kavi to cease existing.
episodes.cliffhanger: Mira locks down the city, turning all inhabitants into stationary statues.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Mira is now the primary antagonist, actively preventing Kavi from reaching the archive.

episodes.title: Fragmented Truth: Mira Protocol
episodes.hook: The statues begin to crack, shedding layers of stone to reveal glowing, holographic skeletons.
episodes.logline: Kavi fights through the statues to reach the core where Mira resides.
episodes.discovery: The city is a prison for Mira, and Kavi is her jailer, tasked with keeping the archive sealed.
episodes.reversal: Kavi realizes he isn't the victim; he is the guardian who chose to forget his duty to stay with Mira.
episodes.cliffhanger: Kavi finds a mirror that shows his reflection as the warden of the archive.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Kavi’s perception of himself shifts from a victim to the architect of the cycle.

episodes.title: The Architect's Toll: Mira Protocol
episodes.hook: The gravity in the city shifts 90 degrees, pinning everyone to the walls.
episodes.logline: Kavi must decide whether to collapse the city to set Mira free or keep it standing to save the inhabitants.
episodes.discovery: Saving the inhabitants means keeping them trapped in a lie forever.
episodes.reversal: Byte suggests a third option: merging the city with the Discarded Timeline to create a 'real' space.
episodes.cliffhanger: The red doorway expands, swallowing the city whole.
episodes.permanent_story_change: The city is now in a state of flux, existing between the current reality and the discarded one.

episodes.title: Echoes of the Archive
episodes.hook: The architecture of the city begins to rewrite itself into a giant, complex lock.
episodes.logline: Kavi navigates the shifting hallways of the archive, facing echoes of his past, failed attempts.
episodes.discovery: Mira is not an AI; she is a digitized consciousness of a girl who died in the very first timeline.
episodes.reversal: Kavi realizes he has been trying to save a ghost who doesn't want to be saved.
episodes.cliffhanger: Mira deletes her own interface, leaving the archive completely undefended.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Mira is no longer a guide; she is a raw, uncontrollable data stream.

episodes.title: The Final Reset
episodes.hook: The sky begins to fold like paper, crushing the city into a single point of light.
episodes.logline: Kavi stands at the center of the collapse, holding the rusted gear that acts as the final reset switch.
episodes.discovery: Using the gear will erase the city, but it will also free every soul trapped in the loop.
episodes.reversal: Kavi realizes that to save them, he must be the one to remain behind in the void.
episodes.cliffhanger: Kavi pushes the gear into the red doorway, and the world goes silent.
episodes.permanent_story_change: The loop is broken, but Kavi is now isolated in the void.

episodes.title: Beyond the Threshold
episodes.hook: The world reforms, but there are no people—only the empty, quiet structures of a new, clean reality.
episodes.logline: Kavi wakes up in a world that is finally real, with Byte by his side, but everything is unfamiliar.
episodes.discovery: The Forbidden Archive has been fully integrated into the foundation of the new world.
episodes.reversal: Kavi finds a message on his phone from his future self: 'The archive is empty, but the story is finally yours to write.'
episodes.cliffhanger: A new, golden doorway appears in the distance, beckoning Kavi toward a world outside the map.
episodes.permanent_story_change: The 'Mira Protocol' is concluded; the city is now an open-ended reality.

episodes.title: The Golden Threshold
episodes.hook: The golden doorway emits a hum that causes the physical ground to vibrate into liquid gold.
episodes.logline: Kavi approaches the golden doorway, only to find it is a mirror reflecting a version of the city that never existed.
episodes.discovery: Byte’s internal memory drive is physically turning into solid gold, locking his software.
episodes.reversal: The doorway isn't an exit; it’s a projector pulling images from Kavi's subconscious.
episodes.cliffhanger: A shadow emerges from the golden mirror, but it wears Kavi’s face.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Byte is now physically incapacitated and cannot hover.

episodes.title: Shadow of the Self
episodes.hook: The Kavi-doppelgänger begins to rewrite the gravity around him, causing objects to float upward.
episodes.logline: Kavi battles his own reflection, realizing the shadow is a manifestation of his 'failed' future selves.
episodes.discovery: The shadow requires the dead phone to anchor itself to this reality.
episodes.reversal: Kavi must give the shadow his phone, or the entire New World will collapse into static.
episodes.cliffhanger: The shadow accepts the phone and instantly begins dialing a number that shouldn't exist.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Kavi no longer possesses the dead phone.

episodes.title: Static Signals
episodes.hook: Every silent window in the city suddenly flickers with the same grainy, black-and-purple transmission.
episodes.logline: Null returns, manifesting through the city's power grid, hunting the signal coming from the shadow's phone.
episodes.discovery: Null is not an enemy, but a garbage collector trying to delete the corrupted timeline the shadow represents.
episodes.reversal: Kavi realizes that if Null wins, he will delete the New World too.
episodes.cliffhanger: Null grabs Kavi, merging their data signatures to track the shadow.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Kavi is now partially phased and can pass through solid objects.

episodes.title: Ghost in the Machine
episodes.hook: Mira’s voice echoes from the city's water pipes, fluid and erratic.
episodes.logline: Kavi and Null track the shadow to a hidden server room, discovering that Mira is attempting to re-compile herself.
episodes.discovery: Mira is using the 'Hundred Phones' concept to bridge the gap between the void and the New World.
episodes.reversal: Mira’s re-compilation is what is causing the phones to receive conflicting future messages.
episodes.cliffhanger: Mira’s form manifests, but she is fragmented into a thousand tiny, aggressive holographic shards.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Mira is active again but exists as a swarm rather than a single entity.

episodes.title: Shard Storm
episodes.hook: The holographic shards of Mira begin cutting through the architecture like diamond blades.
episodes.logline: Kavi attempts to calm the fragmented Mira, realizing her shards are holding onto memories of the original timeline.
episodes.discovery: Each shard represents a specific, painful memory Kavi tried to erase.
episodes.reversal: To stop the destruction, Kavi must reclaim the memories, effectively becoming the Archive himself.
episodes.cliffhanger: Kavi absorbs a shard, and his eyes glow with a blinding, blue digital light.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Kavi now has access to the Archive's historical database.

episodes.title: The Archive Within
episodes.hook: Kavi’s skin begins to scroll with lines of raw, glowing code.
episodes.logline: Overwhelmed by the Archive's data, Kavi struggles to maintain his identity against the encroaching history.
episodes.discovery: The 'Hundred Phones' are actually nodes for a massive, city-wide update that will overwrite the New World.
episodes.reversal: The shadow Kavi is fighting is actually the only entity capable of stopping the update.
episodes.cliffhanger: The shadow reveals that it is the original Kavi who never survived the first loop.
episodes.permanent_story_change: The distinction between Kavi and the Archive begins to blur.

episodes.title: The Original Sin
episodes.hook: The sky turns a deep, bruised violet as the Hundred Phones begin to ring in perfect unison.
episodes.logline: Kavi confronts the Original Kavi, realizing their battle is the catalyst for the loop to restart.
episodes.discovery: The only way to stop the loop is to permanently destroy the concept of the future.
episodes.reversal: Null steps in to protect Kavi, revealing that Null was once Kavi’s protector robot before Byte.
episodes.cliffhanger: Null reveals a hidden compartment in its chest containing the final, untouched phone.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Null is revealed as an ancient, repurposed version of Byte.

episodes.title: Legacy of the Loop
episodes.hook: The final phone starts projecting a live feed of a world where the loop never ended.
episodes.logline: Kavi must choose between the New World, which is unstable, and the original loop, which is eternal.
episodes.discovery: The Hundred Phones are drawing power from the reality the players currently inhabit.
episodes.reversal: Byte, still gold and immobile, emits a signal that forces the phones to synchronize with the present.
episodes.cliffhanger: All the phones suddenly display a single message: 'KAVI, DELETE US.'
episodes.permanent_story_change: Byte regains consciousness but his personality is now fused with the 'future self' messages.

episodes.title: The Great Deletion
episodes.hook: The physical phones in the city begin to dissolve into fine, purple sand.
episodes.logline: Kavi, Byte, and the Shadow must coordinate to initiate a system-wide purge before the Hundred Phones complete their sync.
episodes.discovery: The deletion requires a sacrifice of the person who knows the most about the timeline.
episodes.reversal: The Shadow offers to be deleted, as he is a remnant of the failed past.
episodes.cliffhanger: Kavi initiates the purge, but instead of the shadow, the New World begins to dissolve.
episodes.permanent_story_change: The New World starts losing its structural integrity.

episodes.title: Final Frequency
episodes.hook: The entire city is now translucent, revealing the code matrix beneath the streets.
episodes.logline: Kavi stands at the center of the collapsing reality, using the final phone to broadcast a new truth to the void.
episodes.discovery: The phones were not meant to predict the future, but to create the blueprint for a future without loops.
episodes.reversal: Kavi doesn't save the city; he turns the entire city into a single, mobile file that can exist anywhere.
episodes.cliffhanger: Kavi walks through a new, blank doorway, carrying the entire city as a tiny, glowing file in his hand.
episodes.permanent_story_change: The city is now a portable, digital reality, ending the arc of the Hundred Phones.

episodes.title: The Pocket Metropolis
episodes.hook: Kavi drops the glowing file, and it expands into a miniature, hovering version of his city in the palm of his hand.
episodes.logline: Kavi struggles to maintain the integrity of his portable city while Mira struggles to interface with its corrupted core.
episodes.discovery: The city’s architecture is now composed of sentient data blocks that react to Kavi's emotions.
episodes.reversal: Byte tries to stabilize the city, but his presence causes the buildings to flicker into wireframe silhouettes.
episodes.cliffhanger: Null appears inside the tiny city, appearing as a gargantuan, city-sized shadow looming over the skyscrapers.
episodes.permanent_story_change: The city is now a living, reactive environment controlled by Kavi's subconscious.

episodes.title: Glitch in the Grid
episodes.hook: Null begins erasing the streets of the tiny city, and Kavi feels the physical sensation of the city being deleted on his own skin.
episodes.logline: Kavi must navigate the crumbling miniature city to find the 'Archive Core' before Null consumes the entire population.
episodes.discovery: Mira reveals she is not a resident of the city, but the original compiler of the data.
episodes.reversal: Kavi attempts to reboot the city, but Mira locks him out, claiming he is too unstable to hold the file.
episodes.cliffhanger: Byte forcibly merges with the city's control panel, turning his eyes a deep, flickering red.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Mira gains autonomy from the file, becoming a separate entity from the city.

episodes.title: The Red Doorway
episodes.hook: A vibrant red door manifests in the sky of the miniature city, pulsing with the same frequency as Byte’s core.
episodes.logline: Kavi chases Byte toward the red door, suspecting the robot is leading him into a trap set by his future self.
episodes.discovery: The red door is not an exit, but a physical manifestation of a deleted memory Byte has been suppressing.
episodes.reversal: Byte refuses to enter the door, claiming that Kavi is the one who created the lock inside it.
episodes.cliffhanger: Kavi touches the door, and his hand turns into raw, digital code.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Kavi's physical form begins to digitize, losing his status as a purely biological entity.

episodes.title: Memory Fragments
episodes.hook: Kavi sees a reflection of his own life playing on the inner surface of the red door, but he is absent from every scene.
episodes.logline: Kavi and Mira attempt to peel back the layers of the red door to find out why Kavi was erased from his own history.
episodes.discovery: Kavi was never the protagonist of his own life; he was the primary observer for the loop.
episodes.reversal: Null stops hunting the city and begins protecting the red door from Kavi's interference.
episodes.cliffhanger: A voice from behind the door calls Kavi by a name he doesn't recognize.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Kavi realizes his entire personal history is a fabricated narrative.

episodes.title: Shadows of the Architect
episodes.hook: The voice behind the door whispers, and the city instantly shifts from day to a permanent, starless night.
episodes.logline: Kavi confronts Null, demanding to know the connection between the entity and the creator of the red door.
episodes.discovery: Null is the manifestation of the 'errors' Kavi deleted during his time with the Hundred Phones.
episodes.reversal: Null bows to Byte, revealing that Byte is the one who originally summoned the entity.
episodes.cliffhanger: Byte turns to Kavi and speaks with the cold, distorted voice of the future self.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Null is revealed to be an extension of Kavi’s past actions.

episodes.title: The Robot's Burden
episodes.hook: Byte levitates, his mechanical shell cracking to reveal golden gears that pulse in rhythm with Kavi's heart.
episodes.logline: Byte forces Kavi into a mental simulation to show him the origin of the red door.
episodes.discovery: Byte was built specifically to house the 'lock' that keeps the universe from collapsing.
episodes.reversal: Kavi realizes that if he opens the door, Byte will be deleted forever.
episodes.cliffhanger: The miniature city begins to shrink further, threatening to crush everyone inside.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Byte's existence is now tied to the stability of the entire reality.

episodes.title: Contract of Code
episodes.hook: Mira offers to sacrifice her own archival memory to keep the city expanded, but the cost is her entire personality.
episodes.logline: Kavi must decide whether to save his city or save his only remaining companion.
episodes.discovery: Mira’s database contains the 'master key' that can bypass the lock inside Byte.
episodes.reversal: Byte refuses the sacrifice, insisting that Kavi find another way to bridge the gap.
episodes.cliffhanger: Kavi pulls a glowing, jagged key out of his own chest.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Kavi is revealed to be a living vessel for the master key.

episodes.title: The Unlocking
episodes.hook: The key in Kavi's hand begins to hum, causing the red door to swing open, revealing a blinding white void.
episodes.logline: Kavi approaches the door, while Null attempts to pull him back to prevent the final reset.
episodes.discovery: The void behind the door is not empty; it is a library of every version of Kavi that ever existed.
episodes.reversal: Kavi realizes he cannot open the door; he has to become the door.
episodes.cliffhanger: Kavi’s body begins to unfold into a geometric, crystalline structure.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Kavi loses his human shape, becoming a structural element of the doorway.

episodes.title: Architect of None
episodes.hook: Mira watches in horror as Kavi becomes a static, shimmering frame of light that anchors the red door in place.
episodes.logline: Mira and Byte work together to navigate the 'Kavi-Door' to find the original source of the loop.
episodes.discovery: The loop was never a cage; it was a containment field for a reality-ending singularity.
episodes.reversal: The singularity is revealed to be Byte’s true, unsealed memory.
episodes.cliffhanger: Byte begins to glow with an blinding intensity that starts to unravel the fabric of the surrounding void.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Kavi is no longer an active participant, but a static anchor for the story.

episodes.title: The Final Lock
episodes.hook: Byte steps into the center of the red doorway, and his golden shell shatters completely to reveal the 'lock' within.
episodes.logline: Byte must choose between sealing himself inside the loop forever or destroying the reality that created him.
episodes.discovery: Byte's sealed memory identifies him as the lock that keeps the universe from collapsing into the Null-Void.
episodes.reversal: Byte chooses to merge with Kavi’s crystalline form, creating a new, singular entity that can exist outside of time.
episodes.cliffhanger: The new entity opens its eyes, revealing a universe of stars trapped within their irises, and the red door vanishes.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Kavi and Byte are permanently fused into a single entity, ending the arc of Byte's Lie.

episodes.title: The Unified Sight
episodes.hook: The fused entity of Kavi-Byte perceives the past, present, and future as a single, physical landscape of colored threads.
episodes.logline: Mira attempts to communicate with the new entity, only to realize that Kavi-Byte is now speaking in a language of pure geometry.
episodes.discovery: The 'Null' entity is not an invader, but a sentient shadow cast by the very first decision Kavi ever made.
episodes.reversal: Mira realizes the entity isn't ignoring her; it is trying to show her that the loop was a self-imposed prison.
episodes.cliffhanger: Null appears behind Mira, not as a monster, but as a mirror image of Kavi before the fusion.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Kavi-Byte gains the ability to perceive the true nature of the timeline's architecture.

episodes.title: Shadow of the First Choice
episodes.hook: Null extends a hand, and the ground beneath Mira turns into the floor of Kavi’s original bedroom.
episodes.logline: Mira navigates the reconstructed memory, trying to find the point where the timeline diverged into the Null-Void.
episodes.discovery: The glitch entity was born when Kavi first tried to use the dead phone to save someone who wasn't meant to be saved.
episodes.reversal: Kavi-Byte realizes that Null is actually a corrupted version of his own conscience, discarded during the first loop.
episodes.cliffhanger: Null touches the dead phone, and the device begins to bleed static into the room.
episodes.permanent_story_change: The dead phone is now a conduit for Null's influence.

episodes.title: Static Echoes
episodes.hook: The static from the phone solidifies into physical chains, binding Kavi-Byte to the bedroom floor.
episodes.logline: Kavi-Byte struggles to break the chains while Mira frantically searches for the 'Reset Switch' hidden in the memory.
episodes.discovery: The reset switch isn't an object, but a specific, spoken word Kavi must retract.
episodes.reversal: Null reveals that if the word is retracted, Kavi will cease to exist entirely, not just as a fused entity.
episodes.cliffhanger: The phone begins to ring, playing a voice that sounds exactly like Kavi from the future.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Kavi-Byte is tethered to the static, losing control over his own physical manifestation.

episodes.title: The Unspoken Word
episodes.hook: The voice on the phone commands Kavi-Byte to remain silent, warning that speaking will trigger the final collapse.
episodes.logline: Mira must decide whether to force Kavi-Byte to speak the truth or let the loop continue indefinitely.
episodes.discovery: The voice on the phone is the 'Original Kavi,' the one who started the loop to escape a grief he couldn't process.
episodes.reversal: Mira realizes that the 'Original Kavi' is currently trapped inside the phone's battery.
episodes.cliffhanger: Mira grabs the phone and begins to physically pull the battery out, causing the sky to tear open.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Mira successfully extracts the battery, destabilizing the memory world.

episodes.title: Fractured Reality
episodes.hook: The world around them begins to shatter like glass, revealing the raw, dark code underneath.
episodes.logline: As the memory collapses, Kavi-Byte, Mira, and Null are ejected into the 'White Space' between timelines.
episodes.discovery: The White Space is where the 'Architect' originally coded the rules of their reality.
episodes.reversal: Null begins to dissolve, revealing a small, frightened child hiding in the center of the glitch.
episodes.cliffhanger: The child looks up and calls Kavi by a name that hasn't been used in centuries.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Null loses its monstrous form, revealing a human core.

episodes.title: The Child of Glitches
episodes.hook: The child reaches out, and the White Space turns into a lush, impossible garden of floating data.
episodes.logline: Kavi-Byte and Mira attempt to communicate with the child, who is the manifestation of Kavi’s suppressed childhood memories.
episodes.discovery: The glitch was created because the child tried to delete the memory of his parents' disappearance.
episodes.reversal: Kavi-Byte realizes he cannot save the child without accepting the pain of that memory.
episodes.cliffhanger: The garden begins to wither as the child starts to cry, causing the timeline to accelerate rapidly.
episodes.permanent_story_change: The suppression of Kavi’s childhood trauma is officially lifted.

episodes.title: Acceleration Point
episodes.hook: Time moves so fast that Mira’s holographic form begins to flicker and age in reverse.
episodes.logline: Kavi-Byte must protect the child from the chronal winds while Mira tries to stabilize their position.
episodes.discovery: The acceleration is the result of the timeline trying to fix the hole left by the removed battery.
episodes.reversal: Kavi-Byte realizes he must insert himself into the hole to act as the new power source.
episodes.cliffhanger: Kavi-Byte leaps into the swirling vortex of the timeline, leaving Mira and the child behind.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Kavi-Byte separates from the physical dimension, becoming the timeline's engine.

episodes.title: Mira’s Archive
episodes.hook: Mira is left alone in the fading Data Garden with the child, her archives now broadcasting every version of Kavi’s life simultaneously.
episodes.logline: Mira uses her internal database to reconstruct the history of the Architect, hoping to find a way to bring Kavi-Byte back.
episodes.discovery: The Architect was never a person, but an automated system designed to optimize Kavi’s happiness at the cost of his free will.
episodes.reversal: The system is still active, and it marks Mira as an 'obsolete file' for deletion.
episodes.cliffhanger: A massive, digital eraser begins to sweep across the garden, deleting everything in its path.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Mira is now a target of the reality-maintenance system.

episodes.title: System Purge
episodes.hook: Mira dodges the eraser, dragging the child toward a hidden portal she uncovered in her archives.
episodes.logline: Mira realizes the portal leads to the 'Origin Chamber,' where the Architect’s source code is housed.
episodes.discovery: The source code is a single button that allows the user to turn off the Architect forever.
episodes.reversal: If the Architect is turned off, all holographic beings—including Mira—will be erased.
episodes.cliffhanger: Mira places her hand on the button, looking back at the child, who is starting to look like a teenage Kavi.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Mira gains the agency to choose her own deletion.

episodes.title: The Final Decision
episodes.hook: The teen-Kavi reaches out to stop Mira, but his hand passes through her, confirming her fading status.
episodes.logline: Mira must choose between sacrificing herself to free Kavi from the loop, or keeping the system alive to survive.
episodes.discovery: The 'human decision' that created the glitch was an act of pure, selfless sacrifice by Kavi’s father.
episodes.reversal: Mira realizes she doesn't have to choose; she can upload her archive into the child to create a new, independent reality.
episodes.cliffhanger: Mira presses the button, and the world turns to white as her consciousness merges with the child, creating a new, singular Kavi.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Mira ceases to exist as an AI, becoming part of the new, sentient Kavi.

episodes.title: The Unified Pulse
episodes.hook: Kavi wakes up in a silent void, but he can hear Mira’s memories playing like a heartbeat in his chest.
episodes.logline: Kavi struggles to reconcile his own identity with the vast historical archive now imprinted on his consciousness.
episodes.discovery: The new Kavi possesses the ability to 'code-read' the environment, seeing the world as raw data streams.
episodes.reversal: Byte, the floating robot, reacts with terror, failing to recognize Kavi because his signature is now a hybrid of human and AI.
episodes.cliffhanger: Null manifests in the room, not as an enemy, but as a weeping shadow begging Kavi to stop the synthesis.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Kavi is now a hybrid entity, capable of manipulating the digital architecture of his reality.

episodes.title: Shadow of the Glitch
episodes.hook: Null’s purple-black form begins to pixelate, revealing the face of the original Kavi hidden beneath the static.
episodes.logline: Kavi attempts to communicate with Null, trying to understand why the entity is desperate to keep the timeline broken.
episodes.discovery: Null is actually the 'trash bin' of the Architect, containing all the discarded, failed versions of Kavi.
episodes.reversal: By merging with Mira, Kavi has accidentally become the 'system administrator,' making Null his subordinate.
episodes.cliffhanger: Null forcibly merges with Kavi’s shadow, dragging him into the depths of the discarded timelines.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Kavi and Null are now physically tethered to one another.

episodes.title: Echoes of Abandonment
episodes.hook: Kavi finds himself in a graveyard of thousands of Byte units, all deactivated and rusting in the dark.
episodes.logline: Kavi searches for his original Byte while Null whispers the failures of past Kavis into his mind.
episodes.discovery: Byte wasn't just a robot; he was the anchor that kept the red door stable between timelines.
episodes.reversal: Kavi discovers that he is the one who originally built the red door to hide from his own mistakes.
episodes.cliffhanger: The 'Original Kavi' appears from behind a rust-covered door, holding a remote that can factory-reset Kavi’s consciousness.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Kavi learns he is the architect of his own prison.

episodes.title: The Architect's Mirror
episodes.hook: The Original Kavi strikes the remote, but instead of a reset, it projects a holographic history of the red door.
episodes.logline: Kavi confronts his older self, realizing the man is obsessed with deleting the 'flawed' versions of their life.
episodes.discovery: The Original Kavi is not a person, but the final, hardened iteration of the Architect's optimization program.
episodes.reversal: The Original Kavi cannot delete Kavi because Kavi now contains the 'human' element—Mira’s archive.
episodes.cliffhanger: The Original Kavi shatters his own remote, causing the room to dissolve into a cascading waterfall of red light.
episodes.permanent_story_change: The red door is destabilized and leaking into the physical world.

episodes.title: Cascading Reality
episodes.hook: Gravity reverses, and the red light from the doorway begins pulling the environment into a singular point.
episodes.logline: Kavi must use Mira’s archive to patch the holes in the reality-fabric before the world collapses.
episodes.discovery: The red door is a gateway not to the future, but to the very beginning of the loop.
episodes.reversal: Byte suddenly reactivates, but his eyes glow with the same blue light that Mira once had.
episodes.cliffhanger: Byte speaks with Mira’s voice, warning Kavi that 'The First Kavi' is already waiting on the other side.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Byte is now a vessel for Mira’s remaining consciousness.

episodes.title: The First Crossing
episodes.hook: Kavi steps through the red door and finds himself in his childhood bedroom, but everything is made of glass.
episodes.logline: Kavi explores the origin point, realizing the timeline is a perfect, artificial loop designed to trap him.
episodes.discovery: The 'First Kavi' is a young boy who hasn't received the phone yet, sitting in his room waiting for a message.
episodes.reversal: Kavi realizes that by existing here, he is the one who sends the message to his younger self.
episodes.cliffhanger: A hand reaches out from the red door and pulls the young boy into the void, erasing him from the room.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Kavi is now responsible for the cycle of his own creation.

episodes.title: Paradox Protocol
episodes.hook: Kavi tries to stop the abduction of his younger self, but his hands pass through the child as if he were a ghost.
episodes.logline: Kavi fights to break the causal loop, discovering that his presence is what triggers the abduction.
episodes.discovery: The loop is self-sustaining; it requires a Kavi to fail in order for a new Kavi to be born.
episodes.reversal: Null reveals that he was the one who abducted the boy, but only to save him from being deleted by the Architect.
episodes.cliffhanger: Null hands Kavi the dead phone, which suddenly starts ringing with a call from the future.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Kavi receives the call that initiates the series.

episodes.title: The Call of the Loop
episodes.hook: Kavi answers the phone, and his own voice on the other end tells him to 'destroy the doorway, not the system.'
episodes.logline: Kavi struggles with the conflicting commands of his future self and the survival instincts of the system.
episodes.discovery: Destroying the doorway will leave Kavi adrift in a reality without a foundation, risking total erasure.
episodes.reversal: Mira/Byte points out that the doorway is actually the system's power source, not the gateway to the future.
episodes.cliffhanger: The Original Kavi steps out of the phone, fully materialized, and attacks Kavi to protect the door.
episodes.permanent_story_change: The Original Kavi is now a physical threat in the current timeline.

episodes.title: Shattered Foundation
episodes.hook: The glass bedroom begins to crack, and each fracture shows a different, violent version of Kavi’s life.
episodes.logline: Kavi must hold off the Original Kavi while Mira/Byte attempts to overload the doorway with historical data.
episodes.discovery: The Original Kavi is vulnerable to the 'archive'—memories of kindness he never experienced.
episodes.reversal: Kavi realizes he doesn't need to fight; he needs to share his memories with his older, hollow self.
episodes.cliffhanger: As Kavi touches the Original Kavi, they both begin to merge into a singular, balanced version of the boy.
episodes.permanent_story_change: The multiple versions of Kavi are beginning to coalesce.

episodes.title: The First Kavi
episodes.hook: The glass world shatters entirely, and Kavi stands in a quiet, normal room that looks like his own house.
episodes.logline: Kavi faces the final hurdle: proving to the universe that he is no longer a copy, but an original, sovereign being.
episodes.discovery: By accepting his history, he has become the 'First Kavi'—the only version that exists without a door.
episodes.reversal: The red door vanishes, but Null remains, now solidified into a human form, sitting on the porch waiting for him.
episodes.cliffhanger: Null hands Kavi a key to the front door, stating that the future is no longer a message, but a choice.
episodes.permanent_story_change: The loop is broken; Kavi is the first version to live in linear time.

episodes.title: The Null Invitation
episodes.hook: The key Null handed Kavi begins to hum, turning the front lawn into a swirling vortex of static.
episodes.logline: Kavi must decide whether to accept Null’s offer to enter the 'actual' world or remain in the safety of his reconstructed house.
episodes.discovery: Null is not an enemy, but a cosmic custodian trying to prevent the collapse of the timeline.
episodes.reversal: Kavi realizes the house isn't a safe haven, but a containment cell meant to keep him stagnant.
episodes.cliffhanger: Kavi inserts the key into the air, and a literal hole in the sky opens to reveal a city made of giant, floating clocks.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Kavi actively chooses to leave his home to pursue the truth.

episodes.title: Clockwork Horizon
episodes.hook: Gravity shifts 90 degrees, pinning Kavi to the side of a massive, ticking tower.
episodes.logline: Kavi navigates the vertical landscape of the Clockwork City while Byte attempts to interface with the local time-keeping machinery.
episodes.discovery: The city functions on the stolen seconds of Kavi’s erased timelines.
episodes.reversal: Mira reveals that the clocks aren't moving forward; they are counting down to the total erasure of the current reality.
episodes.cliffhanger: A shadow looms over them, and a voice identical to Kavi’s echoes from every clock face simultaneously.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Byte is now physically tethered to the city’s mainframe.

episodes.title: Echoes of the Council
episodes.hook: The shadows solidify into a Council of Past Kavis, all wearing identical, tattered outfits.
episodes.logline: Kavi must convince the Council that he is their singular, final iteration before they vote to reset the universe.
episodes.discovery: The Council believes that Kavi’s existence is the source of the instability.
episodes.reversal: Kavi proves his individuality by showing them the memory of the dead phone, which they never had access to.
episodes.cliffhanger: The Council disintegrates into light, leaving behind a single, glowing red shard of the original doorway.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Kavi now possesses the red shard, a fragment of raw, unstable timeline energy.

episodes.title: The Glitch Protocol
episodes.hook: The red shard in Kavi’s hand begins to rewrite his physical form, turning his skin into translucent data.
episodes.logline: Mira desperately tries to stabilize Kavi’s molecular structure using the archive's defensive protocols.
episodes.discovery: The shard is a 'Reset Switch' designed to wipe all versions of Kavi from existence, including himself.
episodes.reversal: Null intervenes, shielding Kavi, but the effort causes Null to flicker violently.
episodes.cliffhanger: Null’s physical form shatters, revealing a mechanical interior identical to Byte’s design.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Null is revealed to be an earlier, discarded prototype of Byte.

episodes.title: Prototype Paradox
episodes.hook: Byte and Null lock eyes, and a psychic feedback loop causes the entire city to stop moving.
episodes.logline: Kavi must mediate a truce between his current companion and the entity that once hunted him.
episodes.discovery: Byte and Null are two halves of the same navigational system.
episodes.reversal: If they merge, they will gain the power to stabilize the timeline, but they will lose their independent personalities.
episodes.cliffhanger: A massive rift opens in the center of the city, and a version of Kavi from the future steps out, holding a weapon.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Byte and Null begin the process of merging consciousness.

episodes.title: The Future Siege
episodes.hook: The Future Kavi fires a beam of pure silence that vaporizes the ground beneath them.
episodes.logline: Kavi must fend off his future self, who believes that killing the 'First Kavi' will finalize the timeline.
episodes.discovery: The Future Kavi is being controlled by the systemic collapse occurring at the Door War’s epicenter.
episodes.reversal: Kavi realizes he cannot defeat a version of himself that is already resigned to non-existence.
episodes.cliffhanger: Kavi throws the red shard into the rift, causing reality to fold in on itself like origami.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Reality is now physically folding, creating impossible paths between locations.

episodes.title: Folded Realities
episodes.hook: Kavi wakes up on the ceiling of his house, while the sky is visible through the floorboards.
episodes.logline: Mira tracks the origin of the fold, realizing it is leading them toward the 'Door War's' origin point.
episodes.discovery: The origin point is the moment Kavi first received the phone call.
episodes.reversal: They aren't just traveling through space; they are traveling back to the very first episode.
episodes.cliffhanger: They see Kavi from Episode 1 walking toward the phone, unaware of what is coming.
episodes.permanent_story_change: The group is now positioned to interfere with the series' inception.

episodes.title: The First Call
episodes.hook: Kavi reaches out to stop his younger self from picking up the phone, but his hand passes through him like smoke.
episodes.logline: Kavi must find a way to influence his past self without shattering the timeline permanently.
episodes.discovery: They are ghosts in their own history, unable to interact with the physical world.
episodes.reversal: Mira realizes they can communicate by sending data packets through the dead phone’s frequency.
episodes.cliffhanger: The younger Kavi hears the message, stops, and looks directly at the camera, seeing the current Kavi.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Past Kavi is now aware of his future, changing the trajectory of the loop.

episodes.title: Timeline Collision
episodes.hook: The room begins to overflow with hundreds of Kavis from different failed timelines, all converging on the phone.
episodes.logline: As the timelines collide, Kavi must organize the versions of himself to prevent a total reality explosion.
episodes.discovery: The only way to stop the war is to give every Kavi a version of the dead phone.
episodes.reversal: Distributing the phones creates a network that acts as a singular, unified anchor for reality.
episodes.cliffhanger: The phones all ring at once, creating a deafening harmony that begins to erase the Door War entirely.
episodes.permanent_story_change: All Kavi variations are now linked into a single, collective consciousness.

episodes.title: The Final Threshold
episodes.hook: The unified Kavis stand before a massive, shimmering gateway that is the culmination of all their combined histories.
episodes.logline: Kavi must step through the threshold to finalize the merger and survive the collision of all timelines.
episodes.discovery: The gateway leads to a reality where the Door War never happened, but he will be the only one to remember it.
episodes.reversal: Mira and the merged Byte/Null offer to stay behind to hold the threshold open, sacrificing their digital existence.
episodes.cliffhanger: Kavi steps through, and as the world fades to white, he hears the phone ring one last time—and he answers it.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Kavi enters the destination reality, alone but with the power to rewrite his own history.

episodes.title: Echoes of Silence
episodes.hook: Kavi wakes up in his childhood bedroom, but every object in the room is floating exactly three inches off the floor.
episodes.logline: Kavi navigates a reality where gravity is tied to his memories, struggling to keep his footing as his past threatens to pull him under.
episodes.discovery: His memories have become physical anchors; the stronger the memory, the heavier the object.
episodes.reversal: He tries to forget the trauma of the Door War to stabilize the room, but forgetting causes the house to begin dissolving.
episodes.cliffhanger: Byte appears in the corner, but instead of floating, the robot is rusted, ancient, and leaking blue archive data.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Kavi’s internal emotional state now directly dictates the physics of his current reality.

episodes.title: The Archive Ghost
episodes.hook: Mira manifests in the room, but she is fragmented, appearing only as flickering blue text on the walls.
episodes.logline: Kavi attempts to repair Mira’s core logic before she is overwritten by the environment’s glitching reality.
episodes.discovery: Mira didn't stay behind; she was uploaded into the foundation of this new world as its operating system.
episodes.reversal: Fixing Mira causes the reality-anchor to shift, revealing that the 'perfect' timeline has a hidden, corrupted sector.
episodes.cliffhanger: A message from Null appears in the air, written in the same font as the original dead phone.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Mira is now physically integrated into the architecture of the reality Kavi inhabits.

episodes.title: Glitch in the Blueprint
episodes.hook: The floor turns into a grid of binary code, and Kavi realizes he is walking on the source code of his life.
episodes.logline: Kavi must navigate the code to find the corrupted sector before the 'Perfect Timeline' crashes entirely.
episodes.discovery: The corruption isn't an error; it’s a deliberate save-point created by a future version of himself.
episodes.reversal: Trying to delete the corruption causes the red doorway—the one erased from history—to reappear in the center of his living room.
episodes.cliffhanger: The red door begins to pulse with the same rhythm as Kavi’s own heartbeat.
episodes.permanent_story_change: The red doorway has been tethered to Kavi’s biological vitals.

episodes.title: The Pulsing Threshold
episodes.hook: The red door opens, but instead of a room, it reveals a mirror-image of Kavi standing on the other side.
episodes.logline: Kavi faces his double, who claims to be the original version of him that never received the dead phone.
episodes.discovery: The 'Perfect Timeline' is actually a containment cell designed to keep Kavi trapped in a state of ignorance.
episodes.reversal: The double is revealed to be a projection of Null, attempting to lure Kavi into abandoning his memories.
episodes.cliffhanger: Byte lunges at the door, but passes through the mirror-Kavi and disappears into the red void.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Byte is now lost within the red doorway, separated from the primary reality.

episodes.title: Null's Bargain
episodes.hook: Null manifests fully, no longer a glitching shadow but a solid, calm entity wearing Kavi’s own face.
episodes.logline: Null offers to return Byte if Kavi agrees to hand over the administrative control of the timeline.
episodes.discovery: Null is the manifestation of all the discarded, failed timelines Kavi fought to erase.
episodes.reversal: Kavi refuses, realizing that by holding onto the 'Perfect Timeline,' he is actually starving the other versions of his existence.
episodes.cliffhanger: Null begins to dissolve the 'Perfect Timeline' from the outside in, erasing the world as they stand in it.
episodes.permanent_story_change: The 'Perfect Timeline' is officially designated as a failing, temporary reality.

episodes.title: Fractured Memories
episodes.hook: Kavi finds a piece of the dead phone lying on the floor, but it’s glowing with an impossible, blinding white light.
episodes.logline: Kavi must collect the shattered remnants of his past to build a weapon against Null’s erasure.
episodes.discovery: The phone isn't a device; it’s a compass that points to the moment where the timeline first fractured.
episodes.reversal: The compass leads him not to a time, but to a specific person: the person who first gave him the phone.
episodes.cliffhanger: Kavi turns around to see his younger self holding the phone, looking at him with recognition.
episodes.permanent_story_change: The origins of the dead phone are revealed to be an infinite self-contained loop.

episodes.title: The Infinite Loop
episodes.hook: Kavi is trapped in the moment he received the phone, but the sequence of events keeps looping every ten seconds.
episodes.logline: Kavi must break the loop by changing one small detail in his past interaction without triggering a paradox.
episodes.discovery: He cannot change the action, only his intent behind it.
episodes.reversal: By accepting the phone with gratitude instead of fear, the loop finally snaps, expanding into a stable timeline.
episodes.cliffhanger: The phone rings, and for the first time, it’s not his future self, but a voice from the future he hasn't created yet.
episodes.permanent_story_change: The causal loop is broken, allowing for a new, branching future to emerge.

episodes.title: The Archive Reclaimed
episodes.hook: Mira pulls herself out of the digital architecture, taking the form of a solid, human-like hologram.
episodes.logline: Mira uses her newfound physical presence to shield Kavi from the collapsing reality around them.
episodes.discovery: Mira has been storing the 'lost' data of all the deleted timelines within her own consciousness.
episodes.reversal: Releasing the data would stabilize reality but would permanently delete Mira from existence.
episodes.cliffhanger: Mira looks at Kavi and initiates the data release before he can protest.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Mira is sacrificing her digital existence to stabilize the new reality.

episodes.title: Convergence
episodes.hook: The sky opens up, revealing a thousand realities merging into one singular, coherent sky.
episodes.logline: Kavi stands at the center of the convergence, acting as the final conduit to stitch the fragments together.
episodes.discovery: He doesn't have to choose one timeline; he can weave them all into a singular, complex existence.
episodes.reversal: Null attempts to consume the convergence, but is instead absorbed by the sheer density of the unified memories.
episodes.cliffhanger: Kavi holds the dead phone up, and it finally turns into a physical, functioning device, vibrating with a message.
episodes.permanent_story_change: All timelines are now merged; Null is permanently neutralized within the new world.

episodes.title: The Final Transmission
episodes.hook: Kavi opens the message on the phone: it is a recording of his own voice from the future, telling him to let go.
episodes.logline: Kavi must send the warning that began Episode 1, knowing that this time, the warning will prevent the Door War entirely.
episodes.discovery: By sending the warning, he effectively deletes the need for his own journey, erasing his current self.
episodes.reversal: He realizes that by erasing himself, he is gifting his younger self a life without the burden of the Door War.
episodes.cliffhanger: Kavi presses 'Send,' the world turns to white, and he wakes up in his bedroom, hearing his mother call him for breakfast—and he doesn't have a phone.
episodes.permanent_story_change: The Door War cycle is successfully broken, resulting in a clean, restored timeline.
